vh-2-2-3-12.title: The Greased Plank
vh-2-2-3-12.text: Slick timber offers a sudden, perilous shortcut where the upper walkway has buckled under rime frost. You slide down a short, greased loading plank, your heels spitting white chips of pine as the heavy bronze clapper hums against your spine. The drop deposits you sharply onto a narrow ledge overlooking the churning gray abyss of the lower gorge.
exits: Step out onto the limestone ledge

vh-2-2-3-13.title: The Iron Gate
vh-2-2-3-13.text: Heavy iron slams down across the swaying bridge with a dull, echoing clang that rattles through your teeth. A toll-master's clerk plants his boots on the threshold, demanding an exorbitant inspection fee in copper before you can take another step with the temple metal. Behind you, the creak of tensioned hemp reminds you that every moment spent bargaining brings the ice-wind closer.
exits: Pay the steep toll in coin

vh-2-2-3-14.title: The Singing Cables
vh-2-2-3-14.text: Overhead webs of thick rigging vibrate with a mournful, singing resonance that mimics the mountain wind through stone flutes. You duck low beneath the shivering iron wires, feeling the metallic tang of frozen grease prickle the back of your throat. Every taut strand seems alive, humming warnings about the treacherous descents waiting beyond the market stalls.
exits: Head toward the bronze warning gong
Turn back toward the inner market

vh-2-2-3-15.title: The Bolting Pack-Mule
vh-2-2-3-15.text: Panic erupts as a tethered pack-mule snaps its hempen tie and charges straight down the narrow plankway toward your laden frame. You leap instinctively to the side, scrambling atop a towering stack of fragrant pine twine just as the frantic beast clatters past. Dust and loose straw settle over your boots while the muffled shouts of merchants fade into the whistling wind.

vh-2-2-4-0.title: The Final Anchor
vh-2-2-4-0.text: Aching muscles protest as you haul your frame onto the final stone anchor-platform of the rope markets. The last tethered huts and swaying platforms fade rapidly into a thick blanket of white fog, cutting off the upper tier from the world below. Your boots find solid, unyielding masonry at last, offering a brief respite from the dizzying swing of the cables.
exits: Shoulder your burden toward the haze
Face the cold draft from the terraces

vh-2-2-4-1.title: The Unlatched Gate
vh-2-2-4-1.text: Heavy iron links rattle against the winch-post as Brin drags the security chain aside with a calloused hand, grunting against the morning frost. The bronze clapper shifts on your back, its cold metal humming a dull note through your woolen tunic. A gap opens between the swaying hemp booths of the upper market and the sheer stone descent carved into the mountain flank. Behind you, the pulleys of the Ropewrights' Guild whine in the thin air, while ahead the steps drop away into the pale mist of the gorge.
exits: Follow the draft toward the terraces

vh-2-2-4-2.title: Leaving the Market
vh-2-2-4-2.text: The low roar of the rope bazaars fades into the whistling mountain wind as you adjust the padded cradle carrying the heavy bronze tongue of Orison. Frost coats your eyebrows, and every breath plumes white against the gray granite of the cliff wall. Below your boots, the world breaks into sheer drops and hanging tiers where the stair-towns cling like swallow nests. The air smells intensely of hemp grease and old snow, clean and bitter in your lungs.
exits: Keep walking into the gray haze

vh-2-2-4-3.title: The Frozen Trough
vh-2-2-4-3.text: Ice rims the edges of the stone watering trough, trapping dry barley straw blown from the tiers above. You lean your weight against the frozen rim, letting the heavy bronze clapper rest for a precious moment while your shoulders stop throbbing. In the distance, the wooden wings of the Terrace Millers' windmills turn in jerky rhythms against the pale sky, clicking like dry bones. The air smells of cold stone and distant woodsmoke.
exits: Walk toward the upper market haze

vh-2-2-4-4.title: The Lookout's Horn
vh-2-2-4-4.text: A flat, mournful blast from the Cable Court horn rolls over the swinging stalls, setting the hemp cables vibrating beneath your boots. A lookout leans over a timber rail in the mist, marking your passage in a grease-stained tally book with a blunt piece of chalk. The bronze clapper hums in response to the brass horn, a sympathetic vibration that rattles straight through your spine. You stand at the crossroads of the market shelf, where several paths carve their way into the white abyss.
exits: Follow the draft to the terrace edge
Turn back toward the iron turnstile

vh-2-2-4-5.title: The Narrow Gap
vh-2-2-4-5.text: Rough timbers scrape against your shoulders as you squeeze through the tight alley between two creaking winch-houses, leaving the main bazaar behind. Shouts echo from the inspectors' station where officials are checking travelers for unpaid toll-badges, but the shadows here are deep and blue. The bronze clapper stays muffled against your padded wool, silent for once as you crouch near the edge of the cliff.
